ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 92% of the visible surface with low-intensity (black) pixel distribution restricted to the distal tips and trailing edge boundaries.

Low-intensity black banding occurs along the trailing edge, widening at the lateral tips. A singular, high-contrast dark circular pixel cluster is located in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe.
